svg.metadata:
{"diagram_source":"workflow.d2","management_instructions":"Read this article and the canonical `workflow.d2` source. Treat each node ID as a **checkpoint, not a mandatory sequential checklist**. First inspect the target repository, PRs/issues and the latest conversation context. Report the current node, concrete evidence, unresolved decisions, and the permitted next node(s). If the work is already at review, do not restart planning without reason. If a major design conflict appears, do not force a superficial patch: return to clarification and reconcile the issues.

At each checkpoint: identify the workstream, inspect actual GitHub state, find the current actor and action, distinguish automatic routing from human approval, perform authorised work, verify tool results, then record the transition and any blocker. A Chat LLM without GitHub capabilities must say so and prepare an actionable prompt or human step instead of pretending it updated a PR. Conversely, when it *can* maintain an issue, PR description or merge-readiness state, it should not bounce routine administration to the coding worker.

Use these compact status fields when resuming a conversation:

| Field | Expected content |
| --- | --- |
| Workstream | Repository, objective, conversation context and milestone |
| Current node | One of the IDs linked below, plus actual GitHub refs |
| Specification | Canonical issues, PRs and accepted decisions |
| PR tree | Parent/child/sibling relationships, blockers and mergeable leaves |
| Verification | Tests, current head, CI classification and gaps |
| Next action | Exact action, responsible actor, and any human approval required |
| Exit | Completed, deferred with trigger, or abandoned |","node_count":58,"node_description_selector":"g[data-workflow-node] > desc","schema":"agent-workflow-node-guidance/v2","source":"index.md"}

g.desc:
ST01 — Initial release Actor: Human. State: Repository + first release. A new project or first public version.
Enter from: Independent starting point.
Move to: WS01 Open one workstream when repo/initial.

text.tspan: START A NEW PROJECT OR FIRST RELEASE.

g.title: Human: A new project or first public version

g.desc:
ST02 — Planned change Actor: Human. State: Feature, minor or major. A feature or change of any size; classify scope later.
Enter from: Independent starting point.
Move to: WS01 Open one workstream when planned change.

text.tspan: ASK FOR A FEATURE OR IMPROVEMENT.

g.title: Human: A feature or change of any size; classify scope later

g.desc:
ST03 — Bug or defect Actor: Human. State: Observed behaviour. An observed failure, including interactive Flutter problems.
Enter from: Independent starting point.
Move to: BG01 Capture reproduction when bug.
g.title: Human: An observed failure, including interactive Flutter problems

g.desc:
ST04 — Maintenance Actor: Human. State: Dependencies, tooling, audit. Manual or automated upkeep; also may be folded into another workstream.
Enter from: Independent starting point.
Move to: WS01 Open one workstream when maintenance / audit.
g.title: Human: Manual or automated upkeep; also may be folded into another workstream

g.desc:
ST05 — Existing work Actor: Human. State: PR, CI, stalled task. Resume an existing issue, PR tree or review checkpoint.
Enter from: Independent starting point.
Move to: RV01 Inspect actual PR state when resume current PR.

text.tspan: RESUME AN ISSUE, PR OR STALLED TASK.

g.title: Human: Resume an existing issue, PR tree or review checkpoint

g.desc:
ST06 — Release request Actor: Human. State: Already merged work. Release-only entry that does not require new code.
Enter from: Independent starting point.
Move to: RL01 Recommend release intent when release-only.

text.tspan: PUBLISH WORK THAT IS ALREADY MERGED.

g.title: Human: Release-only entry that does not require new code

g.desc:
WS01 — Open one workstream Actor: Chat LLM. State: One chat, many related PRs. Carry objective, linked GitHub state and next action; multiple independent chats may run.
Enter from: ST01 Initial release (repo/initial); ST02 Planned change (planned change); ST04 Maintenance (maintenance / audit).
Move to: WS02 Inspect current baseline when inspect.

text.tspan: KEEP THIS WORK IN ONE FOCUSED CHAT.

g.title: Chat LLM: Carry objective, linked GitHub state and next action; multiple independent chats may run

g.desc:
WS02 — Inspect current baseline Actor: Chat LLM. State: Code, issues, PRs, releases. Check current repository state, existing specifications and outstanding dependencies.
Enter from: WS01 Open one workstream (inspect).
Move to: WS03 Select discovery depth? when classify.

text.tspan: CHECK THE CODE AND OUTSTANDING WORK.

g.title: Chat LLM: Check current repository state, existing specifications and outstanding dependencies

g.desc:
WS03 — Select discovery depth? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Bug, small or architectural. Choose proportionate analysis; do not demand a full roadmap for a trivial fix.
Enter from: WS02 Inspect current baseline (classify).
Move to: PL01 State detailed intent when major / initial / unclear; SP01 Reconcile GitHub issues when minor / clear / routine; BG01 Capture reproduction when bug discovered.

text.tspan: CHOOSE HOW MUCH PLANNING IS NEEDED.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Choose proportionate analysis; do not demand a full roadmap for a trivial fix

g.desc:
BG01 — Capture reproduction Actor: Human. State: Logs, steps, environment. Share observed and expected behaviour, stack traces, device or UI observations.
Enter from: ST03 Bug or defect (bug); WS03 Select discovery depth? (bug discovered); BG05 Confirm defect hypothesis (not reproduced).
Move to: BG02 How to debug? when evidence.
g.title: Human: Share observed and expected behaviour, stack traces, device or UI observations

g.desc:
BG02 — How to debug? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Size, complexity, tooling. Select human interactive, Chat LLM research or Coding LLM investigation.
Enter from: BG01 Capture reproduction (evidence).
Move to: BG03 Interactive diagnosis when interactive UI; BG04 Delegate diagnosis when delegate.
g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Select human interactive, Chat LLM research or Coding LLM investigation

g.desc:
BG03 — Interactive diagnosis Actor: Human. State: Run UI, debugger, device. Especially for Flutter: reproduce with the human, copy evidence and results back to chat.
Enter from: BG02 How to debug? (interactive UI); EX01 Who implements? (human UI debugging).
Move to: BG05 Confirm defect hypothesis when copy findings.

text.tspan: REPRODUCE AND INSPECT THE ISSUE TOGETHER.

g.title: Human: Especially for Flutter: reproduce with the human, copy evidence and results back to chat

g.desc:
BG04 — Delegate diagnosis Actor: Chat LLM. State: Chat or coding model. Investigate code or ask for focused coding-agent debugging when needed.
Enter from: BG02 How to debug? (delegate).
Move to: BG05 Confirm defect hypothesis when analysis.

text.tspan: ASK CHAT OR A CODING AGENT TO INVESTIGATE.

g.title: Chat LLM: Investigate code or ask for focused coding-agent debugging when needed

g.desc:
BG05 — Confirm defect hypothesis Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Evidence, regression test. Compare candidate cause to observed failure and decide if more diagnosis is required.
Enter from: BG03 Interactive diagnosis (copy findings); BG04 Delegate diagnosis (analysis).
Move to: BG01 Capture reproduction when not reproduced; SP01 Reconcile GitHub issues when cause sufficient; PL01 State detailed intent when needs redesign.

text.tspan: CHECK WHETHER THE CAUSE FITS THE EVIDENCE.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Compare candidate cause to observed failure and decide if more diagnosis is required

g.desc:
PL01 — State detailed intent Actor: Human. State: Voice, prose, examples. Describe what, why, constraints, examples and desired approach; answer and ask questions.
Enter from: WS03 Select discovery depth? (major / initial / unclear); BG05 Confirm defect hypothesis (needs redesign); PL05 Enough specified? (not enough); RV04 What needs changing? (requirements conflict); RL04 Audit public exposure (fundamental quality failure).
Move to: PL02 Ask clarifying questions when draft intent.

text.tspan: EXPLAIN THE GOAL, CONSTRAINTS AND EXAMPLES.

g.title: Human: Describe what, why, constraints, examples and desired approach; answer and ask questions

g.desc:
PL02 — Ask clarifying questions Actor: Chat LLM. State: Missing requirements. Ask targeted questions; revise scope after every material change.
Enter from: PL01 State detailed intent (draft intent); PL04 Resolve ambiguities (more questions).
Move to: PL03 Find contradictions when questions answered.

text.tspan: ASK WHAT IS MISSING OR UNCLEAR.

g.title: Chat LLM: Ask targeted questions; revise scope after every material change

g.desc:
PL03 — Find contradictions Actor: Chat LLM. State: Conflicts and trade-offs. Challenge incompatible requirements, tests or architecture; revisit earlier decisions.
Enter from: PL02 Ask clarifying questions (questions answered).
Move to: PL04 Resolve ambiguities when conflicts identified.
g.title: Chat LLM: Challenge incompatible requirements, tests or architecture; revisit earlier decisions

g.desc:
PL04 — Resolve ambiguities Actor: Human. State: Choose or defer decisions. Discuss alternatives, settle contradictions, or defer non-blocking questions explicitly.
Enter from: PL03 Find contradictions (conflicts identified).
Move to: PL02 Ask clarifying questions when more questions; PL05 Enough specified? when decisions/deferred.

text.tspan: AGREE ON ANSWERS OR DEFER OPEN QUESTIONS.

g.title: Human: Discuss alternatives, settle contradictions, or defer non-blocking questions explicitly

g.desc:
PL05 — Enough specified? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Proceed, continue, defer. Advance when sufficient, not necessarily complete; otherwise loop or park.
Enter from: PL04 Resolve ambiguities (decisions/deferred).
Move to: PL01 State detailed intent when not enough; EN02 Deferred / blocked when defer; EN03 Abandoned when abandon; SP01 Reconcile GitHub issues when sufficient.

text.tspan: DECIDE WHETHER THERE IS ENOUGH TO START.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Advance when sufficient, not necessarily complete; otherwise loop or park

g.desc:
SP01 — Reconcile GitHub issues Actor: Chat LLM. State: Specification register. Search existing issues and PRs; align expected outcomes and acceptance cases.
Enter from: WS03 Select discovery depth? (minor / clear / routine); BG05 Confirm defect hypothesis (cause sufficient); PL05 Enough specified? (sufficient); RV04 What needs changing? (issue/spec mismatch).
Move to: SP02 Issue record adequate? when reconcile.

text.tspan: MATCH THE WORK TO EXISTING GITHUB ISSUES.

g.title: Chat LLM: Search existing issues and PRs; align expected outcomes and acceptance cases

g.desc:
SP02 — Issue record adequate? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Create, update, reuse. Check missing tests, issue ownership, resolving scope and change implications.
Enter from: SP01 Reconcile GitHub issues (reconcile).
Move to: SP03 Request issue approval when new issue / major reframe; SP04 Persist accepted spec when existing issues valid.

text.tspan: CHECK WHETHER AN ISSUE COVERS THE WORK.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Check missing tests, issue ownership, resolving scope and change implications

g.desc:
SP03 — Request issue approval Actor: Human. State: New or material rewrite. Approve new issue creation or significant scope changes; maintain existing records when authorised.
Enter from: SP02 Issue record adequate? (new issue / major reframe).
Move to: SP04 Persist accepted spec when approved; EN02 Deferred / blocked when not approved yet.

text.tspan: GET APPROVAL FOR NEW OR REWRITTEN ISSUES.

g.title: Human: Approve new issue creation or significant scope changes; maintain existing records when authorised

g.desc:
SP04 — Persist accepted spec Actor: Chat LLM. State: Issues + PR descriptions. Record decisions, open questions, criteria and dependencies in GitHub and linked conversation.
Enter from: SP03 Request issue approval (approved); SP02 Issue record adequate? (existing issues valid).
Move to: TR01 Work size and dependency? when existing repository; TR05 Bootstrap repository when new repository approved.
g.title: Chat LLM: Record decisions, open questions, criteria and dependencies in GitHub and linked conversation

g.desc:
TR01 — Work size and dependency? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Single PR or PR tree. Choose scope from dependencies and likely conflicts, not arbitrary linear stacking.
Enter from: SP04 Persist accepted spec (existing repository); TR05 Bootstrap repository (repository ready).
Move to: TR02 Plan PR dependency tree when complex / dependent; EX01 Who implements? when single PR.

text.tspan: DECIDE WHETHER ONE PR IS ENOUGH.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Choose scope from dependencies and likely conflicts, not arbitrary linear stacking

g.desc:
TR02 — Plan PR dependency tree Actor: Chat LLM. State: Conflict and merge ordering. Map sibling PRs that can merge independently and dependent children that must wait.
Enter from: TR01 Work size and dependency? (complex / dependent).
Move to: TR03 Select runnable node when tree dependencies.

text.tspan: MAP PR DEPENDENCIES AND MERGE ORDER.

g.title: Chat LLM: Map sibling PRs that can merge independently and dependent children that must wait

g.desc:
TR03 — Select runnable node Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Milestone + unblocked branch. Choose a ready node; if one branch blocks, advance an independent sibling.
Enter from: TR02 Plan PR dependency tree (tree dependencies); RV10 More work in PR tree? (next sibling / child).
Move to: EX01 Who implements? when ready node; EN02 Deferred / blocked when all nodes blocked; EN03 Abandoned when cancel milestone.

text.tspan: PICK WORK THAT IS READY AND UNBLOCKED.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Choose a ready node; if one branch blocks, advance an independent sibling

g.desc:
TR05 — Bootstrap repository Actor: Chat LLM. State: Source, CI, licence and docs. After human scope approval, initialise the repository, essential CI, documentation and licence, delegating source setup to the coding model as needed.
Enter from: SP04 Persist accepted spec (new repository approved).
Move to: TR01 Work size and dependency? when repository ready.

text.tspan: SET UP THE REPO, TESTS AND DOCUMENTATION.

g.title: Chat LLM: After human scope approval, initialise the repository, essential CI, documentation and licence, delegating source setup to the coding model as needed

g.desc:
TR04 — Milestone gate Actor: Human. State: Dogfood, testable, complete. Confirm which portion of the tree is sufficient to test or merge now.
Enter from: Independent starting point.
Move to: RV01 Inspect actual PR state when test milestone.

text.tspan: AGREE WHAT IS READY TO TEST OR MERGE.

g.title: Human: Confirm which portion of the tree is sufficient to test or merge now

g.desc:
EX01 — Who implements? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Chat patch, coding agent, human. For small changes try direct Chat LLM fix when able; otherwise write a prompt for Codex/Agy.
Enter from: TR01 Work size and dependency? (single PR); TR03 Select runnable node (ready node).
Move to: EX05 Direct small patch when tiny + chat capable; EX02 Prepare implementation when coding model; BG03 Interactive diagnosis when human UI debugging.

text.tspan: CHOOSE BETWEEN A DIRECT FIX AND AN AGENT.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: For small changes try direct Chat LLM fix when able; otherwise write a prompt for Codex/Agy

g.desc:
EX02 — Prepare implementation Actor: Chat LLM. State: Prompt + branch + tests. Specify accepted issue state, exact branch, constraints, tests, dependency tree and expected PRs.
Enter from: EX01 Who implements? (coding model); RV06 Complex correction (corrective prompt).
Move to: EX03 Code and test locally when prompt approved.
g.title: Chat LLM: Specify accepted issue state, exact branch, constraints, tests, dependency tree and expected PRs

g.desc:
EX03 — Code and test locally Actor: Coding LLM (Codex/Agy). State: Coding LLM in container. Use agent in interactive or YOLO container; iterate on code, tests and generator output.
Enter from: EX02 Prepare implementation (prompt approved).
Move to: EX04 Publish PR tree when tests and code.

text.tspan: BUILD THE CHANGE AND RUN REAL TESTS.

g.title: Coding LLM (Codex/Agy): Use agent in interactive or YOLO container; iterate on code, tests and generator output

g.desc:
EX04 — Publish PR tree Actor: Coding LLM (Codex/Agy). State: Branches and draft PRs. Push real commits and create the promised PRs, with explicit dependent bases and linked issues.
Enter from: EX03 Code and test locally (tests and code).
Move to: RV01 Inspect actual PR state when published.

text.tspan: PUSH CODE AND OPEN LINKED PULL REQUESTS.

g.title: Coding LLM (Codex/Agy): Push real commits and create the promised PRs, with explicit dependent bases and linked issues

g.desc:
EX05 — Direct small patch Actor: Chat LLM. State: Chat LLM, if capable. Use available tooling to edit and test an isolated authorised branch, publish an inspectable PR.
Enter from: EX01 Who implements? (tiny + chat capable).
Move to: RV01 Inspect actual PR state when published.

text.tspan: APPLY AND TEST A SMALL CHANGE IN CHAT.

g.title: Chat LLM: Use available tooling to edit and test an isolated authorised branch, publish an inspectable PR

g.desc:
RV01 — Inspect actual PR state Actor: Chat LLM. State: Diff, head, issue, ancestry. Verify published commits, comments, PR metadata, dependencies and fresh tests.
Enter from: ST05 Existing work (resume current PR); TR04 Milestone gate (test milestone); EX04 Publish PR tree (published); EX05 Direct small patch (published); RV05 Small repair (republished).
Move to: RV02 Classify CI signal when current head.

text.tspan: INSPECT WHAT THE PR ACTUALLY CONTAINS.

g.title: Chat LLM: Verify published commits, comments, PR metadata, dependencies and fresh tests

g.desc:
RV02 — Classify CI signal Actor: Chat LLM. State: Passed, failed, pending, quota. Required checks cannot be marked passed if absent; rerun or use accepted alternatives.
Enter from: RV01 Inspect actual PR state (current head).
Move to: RV03 Review correctness? when CI evidence / disclosed gaps; EN02 Deferred / blocked when required CI blocked.

text.tspan: CHECK WHICH CI RESULTS CAN BE TRUSTED.

g.title: Chat LLM: Required checks cannot be marked passed if absent; rerun or use accepted alternatives

g.desc:
RV03 — Review correctness? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Human + Chat evidence. Check behaviour, issue match, closing keywords, test quality, conflicts and merge ordering.
Enter from: RV02 Classify CI signal (CI evidence / disclosed gaps).
Move to: RV04 What needs changing? when findings.

text.tspan: COMPARE THE PR WITH REQUIREMENTS AND TESTS.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Check behaviour, issue match, closing keywords, test quality, conflicts and merge ordering

g.desc:
RV04 — What needs changing? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Simple, complex, spec, ready. Route repair to smallest appropriate stage, including back to Q&A and issue specifications.
Enter from: RV03 Review correctness? (findings); RV07 Human PR review (human objections); RV08 Merge approved? (changes requested).
Move to: RV05 Small repair when simple conflict/fix; RV06 Complex correction when complex repair; PL01 State detailed intent when requirements conflict; SP01 Reconcile GitHub issues when issue/spec mismatch; RV07 Human PR review when ready; EN03 Abandoned when work no longer wanted.

text.tspan: CHOOSE THE RIGHT CORRECTION OR REVIEW PATH.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Route repair to smallest appropriate stage, including back to Q&A and issue specifications

g.desc:
RV05 — Small repair Actor: Human. State: Human or Chat directly. Resolve trivial conflict or tiny fix; Chat may patch when authorised, then republish and review.
Enter from: RV04 What needs changing? (simple conflict/fix).
Move to: RV01 Inspect actual PR state when republished.

text.tspan: FIX A STRAIGHTFORWARD ISSUE OR CONFLICT.

g.title: Human: Resolve trivial conflict or tiny fix; Chat may patch when authorised, then republish and review

g.desc:
RV06 — Complex correction Actor: Chat LLM. State: Prompt to coding model. Produce targeted prompt for Codex/Agy; repair existing branch/PR when safe.
Enter from: RV04 What needs changing? (complex repair).
Move to: EX02 Prepare implementation when corrective prompt.

text.tspan: SEND A FOCUSED REQUEST TO A CODING AGENT.

g.title: Chat LLM: Produce targeted prompt for Codex/Agy; repair existing branch/PR when safe

g.desc:
RV07 — Human PR review Actor: Human. State: Direction + test milestone. Read changes, test where appropriate, request redesign, defer, or approve.
Enter from: RV04 What needs changing? (ready).
Move to: RV04 What needs changing? when human objections; RV08 Merge approved? when review accepted.

text.tspan: READ AND TEST THE PROPOSED CHANGES.

g.title: Human: Read changes, test where appropriate, request redesign, defer, or approve

g.desc:
RV08 — Merge approved? Actor: Human. State: Current PR only. Explicit approval; passing CI or model readiness is not merge authority.
Enter from: RV07 Human PR review (review accepted).
Move to: RV04 What needs changing? when changes requested; EN02 Deferred / blocked when hold; EN03 Abandoned when cancel work; RV09 Merge eligible node when approved.

text.tspan: DECIDE WHETHER THIS PR MAY BE MERGED.

g.title: Human: Explicit approval; passing CI or model readiness is not merge authority

g.desc:
RV09 — Merge eligible node Actor: GitHub / CI. State: GitHub merge action. Merge only valid, approved PR with required checks and dependency prerequisites satisfied.
Enter from: RV08 Merge approved? (approved).
Move to: RV10 More work in PR tree? when merged.

text.tspan: MERGE A REVIEWED, ELIGIBLE PULL REQUEST.

g.title: GitHub / CI: Merge only valid, approved PR with required checks and dependency prerequisites satisfied

g.desc:
RV10 — More work in PR tree? Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: Parallel siblings, blockers. Update bases and conflicts; choose another ready sibling or pause dependent branch.
Enter from: RV09 Merge eligible node (merged).
Move to: TR03 Select runnable node when next sibling / child; CL01 Audit issues and PRs when milestone complete; EN02 Deferred / blocked when remaining work blocked.

text.tspan: RV10 · MORE WORK IN PR TREE?
CONTINUE ANOTHER PR OR CLOSE THE MILESTONE.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Update bases and conflicts; choose another ready sibling or pause dependent branch

g.desc:
CL01 — Audit issues and PRs Actor: Chat LLM. State: Keywords + real completion. Check Fixes/Closes references, issue statuses, acceptance evidence, final implementation notes.
Enter from: RV10 More work in PR tree? (milestone complete).
Move to: CL02 Notify dependencies when issues correct.

text.tspan: CONFIRM THAT THE RIGHT ISSUES ARE RESOLVED.

g.title: Chat LLM: Check Fixes/Closes references, issue statuses, acceptance evidence, final implementation notes

g.desc:
CL02 — Notify dependencies Actor: Chat LLM. State: Upstream + downstream. Check version constraints, dependent PRs, projects and actionable update notices.
Enter from: CL01 Audit issues and PRs (issues correct).
Move to: CL03 Update Projects repo when notify.

text.tspan: UPDATE ANYTHING THAT DEPENDS ON THIS WORK.

g.title: Chat LLM: Check version constraints, dependent PRs, projects and actionable update notices

g.desc:
CL03 — Update Projects repo Actor: Chat LLM. State: Ideas, work and position. Update arran4/projects with roadmap, workstream and current milestone.
Enter from: CL02 Notify dependencies (notify).
Move to: CL04 Update PR repository when tracker current.

text.tspan: RECORD PROGRESS AND NEXT STEPS IN PROJECTS.

g.title: Chat LLM: Update arran4/projects with roadmap, workstream and current milestone

g.desc:
CL04 — Update PR repository Actor: Chat LLM. State: Announcement readiness. Update arran4/public-relations with accurate materials or future campaign tasks.
Enter from: CL03 Update Projects repo (tracker current).
Move to: RL01 Recommend release intent when evaluate version.
g.title: Chat LLM: Update arran4/public-relations with accurate materials or future campaign tasks

g.desc:
RL01 — Recommend release intent Actor: Human or Chat LLM. State: None, patch, minor, major. Use accepted scope, roadmap, merged changes and release guidance; patch may be routine if authorised.
Enter from: ST06 Release request (release-only); CL04 Update PR repository (evaluate version).
Move to: RL02 Publish now? when release recommendation.

text.tspan: CHOOSE WHETHER AND HOW TO RELEASE THIS WORK.

g.title: Human or Chat LLM: Use accepted scope, roadmap, merged changes and release guidance; patch may be routine if authorised

g.desc:
RL02 — Publish now? Actor: Human. State: Decision or defer. May choose no release, normal versioned release, or delayed/public opening.
Enter from: RL01 Recommend release intent (release recommendation).
Move to: EN01 Completed when no release / done; EN02 Deferred / blocked when defer release; RL03 First public opening? when release approved.

text.tspan: DECIDE WHETHER IT IS TIME TO PUBLISH.

g.title: Human: May choose no release, normal versioned release, or delayed/public opening

g.desc:
RL03 — First public opening? Actor: Human. State: Visibility and history. If private-to-public, require broader quality, provenance, licence, copyright and link checks.
Enter from: RL02 Publish now? (release approved).
Move to: RL07 Run release workflow when already public / private release; RL04 Audit public exposure when first public opening.

text.tspan: CHECK WHETHER THE REPO MUST BECOME PUBLIC.

g.title: Human: If private-to-public, require broader quality, provenance, licence, copyright and link checks

g.desc:
RL04 — Audit public exposure Actor: Chat LLM. State: Links, secrets, licences. Inspect repository history, links, copyright, documentation, quality and release assets.
Enter from: RL03 First public opening? (first public opening).
Move to: RL05 History rewrite needed? when audit findings; PL01 State detailed intent when fundamental quality failure.

text.tspan: CHECK LINKS, LICENCES, SECRETS AND QUALITY.

g.title: Chat LLM: Inspect repository history, links, copyright, documentation, quality and release assets

g.desc:
RL05 — History rewrite needed? Actor: Human. State: Explicit destructive consent. Force-push or rewrite only on explicit informed approval; consider collaborators and tags.
Enter from: RL04 Audit public exposure (audit findings).
Move to: RL06 Approve visibility change when no rewrite / approved rewrite; EN02 Deferred / blocked when rewrite consent pending.

text.tspan: ASK BEFORE REWRITING PUBLISHED GIT HISTORY.

g.title: Human: Force-push or rewrite only on explicit informed approval; consider collaborators and tags

g.desc:
RL06 — Approve visibility change Actor: Human. State: Human-publication gate. Make public only after verified audit and approval.
Enter from: RL05 History rewrite needed? (no rewrite / approved rewrite).
Move to: RL07 Run release workflow when public approved.
g.title: Human: Make public only after verified audit and approval

g.desc:
RL07 — Run release workflow Actor: GitHub / CI. State: Tag dispatch + publisher. Use documented release-safe action to tag and publish; no duplicate release publisher.
Enter from: RL03 First public opening? (already public / private release); RL06 Approve visibility change (public approved).
Move to: RL08 Verify published result when workflow complete.

text.tspan: RUN THE APPROVED TAGGING AND RELEASE ACTION.

g.title: GitHub / CI: Use documented release-safe action to tag and publish; no duplicate release publisher

g.desc:
RL08 — Verify published result Actor: Chat LLM. State: Artifacts, downstream. Confirm actual tag, release, packages and downstream impact; update tracker and announcements.
Enter from: RL07 Run release workflow (workflow complete).
Move to: EN01 Completed when confirmed; EN02 Deferred / blocked when publishing failed.
g.title: Chat LLM: Confirm actual tag, release, packages and downstream impact; update tracker and announcements

g.desc:
EN01 — Completed Actor: GitHub / CI. State: Verified milestone. Work and any authorised release completed; issue and tracker state reconciled.
Enter from: RL02 Publish now? (no release / done); RL08 Verify published result (confirmed).
Move to: Terminal state; a new workstream or recorded trigger is required to resume.
g.title: GitHub / CI: Work and any authorised release completed; issue and tracker state reconciled

g.desc:
EN02 — Deferred / blocked Actor: GitHub / CI. State: Reason + resumption trigger. Record what remains, owner, dependency, and the condition for resuming.
Enter from: PL05 Enough specified? (defer); SP03 Request issue approval (not approved yet); TR03 Select runnable node (all nodes blocked); RV02 Classify CI signal (required CI blocked); RV08 Merge approved? (hold); RV10 More work in PR tree? (remaining work blocked); RL02 Publish now? (defer release); RL05 History rewrite needed? (rewrite consent pending); RL08 Verify published result (publishing failed).
Move to: Terminal state; a new workstream or recorded trigger is required to resume.

text.tspan: RECORD WHAT IS BLOCKED AND WHEN TO RESUME.

g.title: GitHub / CI: Record what remains, owner, dependency, and the condition for resuming

g.desc:
EN03 — Abandoned Actor: Human. State: Reason + consequences. Document cancellation, superseded PRs, issue closure/retention and change of direction.
Enter from: PL05 Enough specified? (abandon); TR03 Select runnable node (cancel milestone); RV04 What needs changing? (work no longer wanted); RV08 Merge approved? (cancel work).
Move to: Terminal state; a new workstream or recorded trigger is required to resume.

text.tspan: STOP THE WORK AND RECORD WHY.

g.title: Human: Document cancellation, superseded PRs, issue closure/retention and change of direction
Human: A new project or first public version
Human: A feature or change of any size; classify scope later
Human: An observed failure, including interactive Flutter problems
Human: Manual or automated upkeep; also may be folded into another workstream
Human: Resume an existing issue, PR tree or review checkpoint
Human: Release-only entry that does not require new code
Chat LLM: Carry objective, linked GitHub state and next action; multiple independent chats may run
Chat LLM: Check current repository state, existing specifications and outstanding dependencies
Human or Chat LLM: Choose proportionate analysis; do not demand a full roadmap for a trivial fix
Human: Share observed and expected behaviour, stack traces, device or UI observations
Human or Chat LLM: Select human interactive, Chat LLM research or Coding LLM investigation
Human: Especially for Flutter: reproduce with the human, copy evidence and results back to chat
Chat LLM: Investigate code or ask for focused coding-agent debugging when needed
Human or Chat LLM: Compare candidate cause to observed failure and decide if more diagnosis is required
Human: Describe what, why, constraints, examples and desired approach; answer and ask questions
Chat LLM: Ask targeted questions; revise scope after every material change
Chat LLM: Challenge incompatible requirements, tests or architecture; revisit earlier decisions
Human: Discuss alternatives, settle contradictions, or defer non-blocking questions explicitly
Human or Chat LLM: Advance when sufficient, not necessarily complete; otherwise loop or park
Chat LLM: Search existing issues and PRs; align expected outcomes and acceptance cases
Human or Chat LLM: Check missing tests, issue ownership, resolving scope and change implications
Human: Approve new issue creation or significant scope changes; maintain existing records when authorised
Chat LLM: Record decisions, open questions, criteria and dependencies in GitHub and linked conversation
Human or Chat LLM: Choose scope from dependencies and likely conflicts, not arbitrary linear stacking
Chat LLM: Map sibling PRs that can merge independently and dependent children that must wait
Human or Chat LLM: Choose a ready node; if one branch blocks, advance an independent sibling
Chat LLM: After human scope approval, initialise the repository, essential CI, documentation and licence, delegating source setup to the coding model as needed
Human: Confirm which portion of the tree is sufficient to test or merge now
Human or Chat LLM: For small changes try direct Chat LLM fix when able; otherwise write a prompt for Codex/Agy
Chat LLM: Specify accepted issue state, exact branch, constraints, tests, dependency tree and expected PRs

Coding LLM (Codex/Agy): Push real commits and create the promised PRs, with explicit dependent bases and linked issues
Chat LLM: Use available tooling to edit and test an isolated authorised branch, publish an inspectable PR
Chat LLM: Verify published commits, comments, PR metadata, dependencies and fresh tests
Chat LLM: Required checks cannot be marked passed if absent; rerun or use accepted alternatives
Human or Chat LLM: Check behaviour, issue match, closing keywords, test quality, conflicts and merge ordering
Human or Chat LLM: Route repair to smallest appropriate stage, including back to Q&A and issue specifications

Human: Read changes, test where appropriate, request redesign, defer, or approve
Human: Explicit approval; passing CI or model readiness is not merge authority
GitHub / CI: Merge only valid, approved PR with required checks and dependency prerequisites satisfied
Human or Chat LLM: Update bases and conflicts; choose another ready sibling or pause dependent branch

Human: Force-push or rewrite only on explicit informed approval; consider collaborators and tags
Human: Make public only after verified audit and approval
